description: This file defines enums, structs, and error types related to Gateway connection authentication errors in a Swift project. It includes error codes, detailed error structures, and error message handling for gateway connection issues.

classes.name: GatewayConnectAuthError
classes.description: A struct representing structured authentication errors during gateway connection attempts, including error messages, detail codes, suggested recovery steps, and retry options.

classes.name: GatewayResponseError
classes.description: A struct representing general error responses from the gateway, including method, code, message, and additional details.

classes.name: GatewayDecodingError
classes.description: A struct representing decoding errors encountered when processing gateway responses, including method and message.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.init
methods.description: Initializes an authentication error with message, detail code, retry flag, and optional next step.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.init
methods.description: Convenience initializer for creating an auth error with message, detail code, retry flag, and next step.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.detailCode
methods.description: Returns an optional string representing the detail code of the error.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.recommendedNextStepCode
methods.description: Returns an optional string representing the recommended next step code.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.detail
methods.description: Returns the enum case of the detail code if valid.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.recommendedNextStep
methods.description: Returns the enum case of the next step if valid.

methods.name: GatewayResponseError.init
methods.description: Initializes a response error with method, code, message, and optional details.

methods.name: GatewayResponseError.errorDescription
methods.description: Provides a localized description of the error based on method, code, and message.

methods.name: GatewayDecodingError.init
methods.description: Initializes a decoding error with method and message.

methods.name: GatewayDecodingError.errorDescription
methods.description: Provides a message describing the decoding error.
